A '''breather blast helmet''' was a [[Blast helmet/Legends|blast helmet]] with a sealed, integrated [[atmosphere processor]]. It provided limited protection against both physical and energy-based attacks. The [[spice-jacker]] [[Romort Raort]] wore a breather blast helmet.
